items.label: Alchip press release: Alchip Technologies Reports 2026 Second Quarter Financial (08-26-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Q2 2026 results release: 87% of the $241.7 million Q2 revenu

set.signal: Q2 2026 results release: 87% of the $241.7 million Q2 revenue came from 7nm and smaller technologies - 3nm/2nm designs 47%, 5nm/7nm designs 40%, 12nm and larger 13%; high-performance computing and Niche applications accounted for 51% of Q2 revenue. By region, North America 51%, Asia Pacific 25%, Japan and the rest of the world 24%. Gross profit was $84.2 million (up 36.7% YoY, 26.8% QoQ) and pre-tax profit $64.4 million (up 23.9% YoY, 14.2% QoQ).

items.label: AIXTRON press release: Strong momentum in optoelectronics continues (07-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: H1 2026 order intake EUR 386.0 million, 54% above the prior

set.signal: H1 2026 order intake EUR 386.0 million, 54% above the prior year (H1/2025: EUR 250.7 million). Equipment order backlog stood at EUR 456.9 million as of June 30, 2026, up from EUR 284.6 million a year earlier and EUR 257.8 million at end-2025. Major laser system shipments are expected to begin in Q3/2026 and continue well beyond the current fiscal year; the company says its project pipeline extends well beyond 2026. H1 free cash flow EUR 162.1 million, driven primarily by higher customer advance payments.
